title: libsufr's unit tests do not compile on dev
body:
`cargo test -p libsufr` fails to compile on dev at b5d5c29 with E0061. b50991f removed the `allow_ambiguity` parameter from `SuffixArrayBuilder::with_dna_options`, which now takes `(is_dna, ignore_softmask)`. 9984777 (PR #14) was squash-merged on top of b50991f, and two of its tests still pass three arguments:

| site | call | two-argument form |
|---|---|---|
| `check_sorted_with_lcp`, `libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs:1353` | `with_dna_options(true, true, false)` | `with_dna_options(false, false)` |
| `test_count_with_a_cap_of_zero`, `libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs:1315` | `with_dna_options(true, false, false)` | `with_dna_options(true, false)` |

`check_sorted_with_lcp` needs every suffix indexed, N included, and `is_dna = false` now gives that. Writing `with_dna_options(true, false)` there compiles and passes too, but `--dna` drops the N suffixes, so `test_equal_n_runs` and `test_n_runs_ending_a_record` would then check no suffix inside a run.

On a scratch copy of dev with the two-argument forms from the last column, all 33 libsufr unit tests and all 46 CLI tests passed.
close_reason: Fixed in 657e16d on dev with the two-argument forms from the table; `cargo test` passes, `test_equal_n_runs` and `test_n_runs_ending_a_record` among them.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: Fixed in the working tree of the main checkout on dev with the two-argument forms from the table, uncommitted. `cargo test` passes: 33 libsufr unit tests, 46 CLI tests, 22 in libsufr/tests and 2 more, `test_equal_n_runs` and `test_n_runs_ending_a_record` among them. Close it once the commit lands.
